title: Over 1,000 Bitcoin miners were tricked into working for a thief by a fake internet route

title: 42 state AGs are trying to stop Character.AI from selling users’ chats
content:
A coalition of 42 state attorneys general is trying to prevent Character.AI from selling off user data as it navigates Chapter 11 bankruptcy proceedings. In a deluge of nearly identical press releases, the various AGs accuse the company of planning to auction off "the private chat histories of more than 21 million U.S. accounts - more than 2.1 million of them registered to minors - with no safeguards for the people whose conversations are being sold."

title: Google’s patent for custom AI video feeds paints a bleak picture of entertainment’s future
content:
Last year, Google filed a patent for a system called My Channel that's designed to create feeds filled with personalized, AI-generated videos and advertisements based on information the company knows about its users. The patent has been rejected, but unfortunately, Google might appeal or resubmit an amended version, and we could see this monstrosity come to market.

title: FCC signs off on SpaceX’s plan to put up to 1 million data center satellites into space
content:
In an announcement on Wednesday, the FCC says it authorized SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million AI chip-equipped satellites as part of the Elon Musk-owned company's "Starmind" initiative. With several others also pursuing the idea of putting AI data centers in space, including Google and Blue Origin, this is the first approval the agency has granted for a full "constellation" of AI satellites.
The FCC's approval requires SpaceX to deploy at least one satellite by 2033, and meet the 1 million satellite milestone by 2040. The FCC also deferred SpaceX's request to dispose of satellites located above 600km in space "graveyard" orbits, rather than  …

title: Nothing offers a full look at its AI earbuds and charging case
content:
Nothing is showing off a much more detailed look at its upcoming AI earbuds ahead of their December 8th release. The Ear Note buds can record your calls, while their charging case can record, transcribe, and summarize your conversations.
Like the Ear 3, the Ear Note's microphone-equipped case comes with a "Talk" button that you can use to record your own voice. There's also a new "Record" button that can record and transcribe your conversations. title: Amazon is reportedly in talks to end Muse AI shopping block
content:
Amazon has held talks about letting Meta's Muse AI agent shop on its online marketplace, according to a report from Fortune. The discussions, which could end Amazon's block on Muse, reportedly center on the kinds of products the AI agent recommends and the potential impact on the ecommerce giant's advertising revenue.
As reported by Fortune, Amazon is concerned that it could lose advertising revenue by allowing Muse on its site, since it depends on actual humans seeing ads across its online marketplace. title: Has vibe coding made open source the new normal for synths?
content:
The emergence of powerful vibe-coding agents and tools like Reverse Engineer Anything has caused chaos in the music gear world, leaving companies scrambling to figure out how to respond. While some, like Roland, have remained silent for now, others have embraced the modding community. In the last several weeks, as it's become clear that no piece of music gear is safe from Claude and a subreddit full of curious tinkerers, companies have begun making more and more of their devices open source.

title: Jensen Huang reportedly tells Nvidia staff it’s ‘not true’ Trump got him rehired
content:
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang apologized to staff during his first all-hands since returning to the company, while attempting to distance himself from the narrative that the White House and tech leaders helped him get his job back, according to reports from Bloomberg, The New York Times, and The Handbasket's Marisa Kabas.
During the meeting, Huang reportedly called claims that President Donald Trump was directly involved in his reinstatement - an idea publicly promoted by Trump himself - "completely untrue." He added, "Don't think for a second politics played a role in the company. We are the most apolitical company," according to Kabas.

title: David Fincher is being dragged for suspected use of AI in his latest film
content:

title: Tidal will start banning AI-generated music next month
content:
Tidal is officially banning AI-generated music on December 9th. As a result of this change, Tidal will delete around 29 million AI-generated songs and reject an estimated 80,000 to 85,000 tracks per day, according to Tidal music lead Robert Andersen.
The move comes just months after Tidal began labeling and demonetizing tracks identified as 100 percent AI-generated. In a post on X, Andersen says Tidal needed to take a more "drastic" measure, as AI music made up 43 percent of the tracks distributed to the platform in the last 90 days.
